data.long_meaning: Andros, man; eon, eternal. From the ancient Greek name Andros, meaning 'man of man' or 'manly man'. In the New Testament, Andros was a disciple of Christ. The name Andeee carries the meaning “An andrea, man of man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Andeee usually hope their child will grow to embody an andrea, man of man and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Andeee total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
